clips.title: The story
paras: Magatha Grimtotem seeks retribution after troggs slaughter her emissaries beneath Orgrimmar. Rahauro on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise sends warriors into Ragefire Chasm to cull the troggs infesting it.

Magatha Grimtotem sent tauren emissaries into the fiery depths beneath Orgrimmar to make peace with the troggs. The creatures slaughtered the delegates as soon as they arrived. Magatha saw the massacre as an insult to the tauren and a growing danger to the Horde. She resolved to answer it with force.

Rahauro carries out Magatha’s orders from Thunder Bluff. He directs warriors into Ragefire Chasm to find and kill trogg warriors and shamans. The Horde strikes deep into their underground home to thin their numbers before they can pour through their tunnels into Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the traveler people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.
She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes your search for the Chasm? And the troggs?
The threat cannot be allowed to persist—it will only injure our orc brethren if it continues.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, friend. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.
Perhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
